errors.server_unreachable: Make sure the server is running.
errors.cli_auth_failed: Failed to authorize CLI. Please log in again.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and that the server is running.
errors.email_not_configured: This server has no email delivery configured — contact your administrator.

server.label: Server
server.unreachable: Cannot reach the Goosar server at {{address}}. Check the address, and that the server is running and reachable from this machine.
server.unreachable_proxy: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. This machine routes that address through the proxy {{proxy}}, so the break is more likely there than at the server — check that the proxy is reachable from here, and that it allows this address.
server.unreachable_proxy_unnamed: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. A proxy sits on this machine's route to that address, so the break is more likely there than at the server.
server.unreachable_proxy_candidates: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. This machine's system settings offer more than one path to that address — {{paths}} — and which of them this request took is not recorded here. Check those paths rather than the server.
server.unreachable_route_unknown: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. The route this machine takes to that address could not be determined, and the app sets no route of its own, so the request went out under this machine's own proxy settings. Check the address, the server, and those proxy settings.
server.unreachable_offline: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. This machine reports no network connection, so the request never left it.
server.unreachable_network_changed: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. This machine's network changed while the request was in flight — a VPN coming up, a switch between networks, or a wake from sleep. Try again — the route this machine takes may have changed with it.
server.unreachable_name: The sign-in request to {{address}} did not get through. A host name on the way could not be resolved on this machine, so the request never left it. Check the address, and this machine's DNS.
server.save_failed: Could not save the server address: {{message}}
server.pins_intro: Changing the server replaces endpoints pinned in desktop.json:
server.pins_outro: The replacements are derived from the new address. Pin them again in desktop.json if this deployment needs different values.

desktop_handoff.opening_description: You should see a prompt to open the Goosar desktop app. If nothing happens, click the button below.

login_link.opening_description: If the Goosar desktop app is installed, your browser should offer to open it and you'll be signed in there. Otherwise, continue in the browser.
login_link.failed_description: The sign-in link has already been used or expired. Request a fresh code on the sign-in page: links work once and expire with the code.
login_link.missing_token: This sign-in link is incomplete. Request a new one on the sign-in page.
